cohort: A cohort of 2763 women who had a singleton pregnancy and live birth from the All Our Families Cohort in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.
finding: Women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy had significantly shorter gestational length, and the strength of this association increased with greater depressive symptom and state anxiety severity.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 37.87 weeks for women with HDP and 38.99 weeks for those without HDP.
